thread:
maria: Quick async check for the new eu3 region (saturn-edge). Need to confirm owners and blockers before we flip DNS. I opened infra PR: https://git.redwood/saturn/infra/pulls/312. TL;DR - route-policy changes, KMS key access, and one infra CR. Who can pick up which item? :eyes:

kevin: I can own route-policy review. Two quick questions: are we keeping prefix TTL=300s for stability or dropping to 60s for faster cutover? Also need the peering CIDRs as a machine-readable file (JSON/YAML) rather than inline in the PR.

maria: Prefer TTL=300s for the first flip to reduce churn. Subnet/peer list is currently inline, i'll extract it to saturn/infra/peer-cidrs/eu3.json and link it in the PR. @kevin i'll ping you there.

ashley: I'll take KMS + residency checks. Need (1) KMS key policy approved by security, (2) confirmation audit export path stays in-region. Legal flagged a DPA addendum for audit exports - might take ~2 business days. Contingency: add toggle to disable cross-border export. I'll add checklist to the ticket.

jonah: Canary/capacity question: do we want staged traffic (5/25/full) or a single 10% soft canary? If Dedicated capacity will be used, we must reserve or fallback to hosted pool. Also request autoscale headroom for +30m after flip.

sam: I vote staged: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> full. Autoscale snippet I used before:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 24
  scale_up_window: 30s
  scale_down_window: 5m
```
Dropping this in the PR comments and linking canary playbook.

deploy-bot: staging/canary pipeline started for saturn-edge-eu3 (build #2029). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/2029 :rocket:

kevin: PR review done for routing diff. Left comments on route-policy ordering and a request to move CIDRs to a file. @sam please confirm autoscale values fit infra quotas.

maria: Assigned reviewers: kevin, ashley, sam. Target milestone: finish reviews and KMS/legal signoff by 2027-06-03 so DNS flip planned 2027-06-05. Raise blockers here ASAP.

ashley: Legal Q completed: DPA addendum pending sign but they approved disabling cross-border exports. I added toggle to the infra PR and a short rollback flag for audit export. Should unblock routing review.

jonah: I'll draft a rollback runbook: if latency SLOs break in first 60m, revert route-policy and failover to hosted pool. Also document the alert thresholds and quick commands.

maria: Perfect. One last ask - sam, can you and kevin sync on peering JSON and autoscale constraints within the next 4hrs? If so i'll move the milestone to "reviews in progress". Otherwise we'll postpone flip.

sam: Yep, syncing now with kevin. Will update PR with autoscale section and add the peer file.

kevin: Got it. Reviewing peer JSON, will post final thumbs by EOD.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the milestone and post a short calendar invite for the cutover window once reviews are green. Ping here if anything changes. :calendar: :thumbsup:
